page.layout: Running head at top centre. Two medallion woodcut portraits with inscriptions, side by side, above the text. One column of running text in two paragraphs below them. Signature "Ff 2" at the foot, right of centre. Page number at top right.

main_text.p: ACHAB regnauit in Israel anno 38.regni Asa Regis Judæ: hic erat annus mundi 3027.ante Christum natum 935. tenuit Achab principatum in Samaria annis 22. omnes priores Reges impietate superauit: duxit vxorem Jezabel Regis Sidoniorum filiam: & posuit aram Baal in templo Baal, quod extruxerat in Samaria, ipsumque Baal adorauit. Prædixit ei Propheta Elias famem, quæ tres annos durauit. posthæc occurrit Achab Eliæ, cui dixit: Tune es ille qui conturbas Israel? respondit Elias: Non ego turbaui Israel, sed tu, & domus patris tui, qui dereliquistis mandata Domini, & secuti estis Baal. Deinde miraculo facto in holocausto Eliæ, eiusdem Eliæ jussu sacerdotes Baal impostores interficiuntur, erant autem 450. Achab semel atque iterum prælio vicit Ben-adab: tertiò contra eundem pugnans mutata etiam veste, sagitta fortuito ad mortem vulneratur. 3.Reg.16.cap.& seq. Josep.lib.Antiq.8.cap.12.&13.

JEZABEL filia Eth-Baal Regis Sidoniorum, vxor fuit huius supradicti Acab. Impia hæc Pseudoprophetis Baal fauens, Eliæ mortem minitata est: quod cùm resciret Elias, aufugit: præterea ipsi Naboth mortem machinata est, qui lapidibus est obrutus, quòd falsis testibus convicisset ipsa Jezabel, eum Deo ac Regi maledixisse. occasio autem inde manarat, quòd vineam, patrum suorum hæreditatem, Regi Achab non permisisset Naboth. Vide lib.3.Reg.19. & 21.cap.& Josephus lib. Antiq.8. cap.13. Hæc jussu Jehu de fenestra præcipitata est, in Jezrahel: cùm, audiens adventum eius, ornasset se, ac fuco faciem deliniuisset: a spersúsque[?] est sanguine paries, & equorum vngulæ conculca-verunt eam: jussitque eam sepeliri Jehu, quòd filia Regis esset: at cùm sepelirent eam, non invenerunt nisi calvariam, & pedes, & summas manus, juxta prædictionem Eliæ, 4.Reg.9.

page.notes: Two woodcut medallion portraits at the top: left, a bearded man in profile (Achab, king of Israel); right, a woman in profile wearing a crown (Jezabel, queen). The inscriptions around the medallions are partly cut off by the frame; the right-hand medallion's left-side inscription reads only "EL REGIN" and is reconstructed as [?]. A small dingbat (asterisk-like mark) stands after "13." at the end of the first paragraph; it is not text. Spelling is normalised to u/v and i/j rules as instructed; the word "spersúsque" is uncertain in the scan.
